summary: Selecting North also returns Northeast rows because the region filter matches substrings instead of exact region values.
root_cause: filterByRegion keeps every row whose region includes the selected text, so the North selection also keeps the four Northeast rows and the chart renders eight bars.

claims.text: After the North selection the filtered dataset contains eight rows, including four Northeast rows, while the expected dataset has four North rows.
The rendered chart shows eight bars with each quarter label repeated instead of four bars for Q1 to Q4.
The defect follows the single committed select-region action that chooses North.
filterByRegion compares regions with String.prototype.includes rather than equality.
